title: CREST: Universal Safety Guardrails Through Cluster-Guided Cross-Lingual Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the performance (F1 scores) of safety classification guardrails across 100 languages, specifically analyzing the disparity in safety enforcement between high-resource and low-resource languages using translated safety benchmarks.

Assessing cultural and contextual robustness by evaluating the models on native cultural safety datasets (IndicSafe and Cultural Kaleidoscope) that contain region-specific safety annotations reflecting local linguistic and cultural norms, rather than relying solely on translated English benchmarks.
